data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open the hotel search, enter the destination and pick a suggestion, choose dates, set rooms and guests, search, then filter and sort) and names the right parameters. It adds details the true workflow doesn't show (children's ages, hotel class and amenity filters), and it puts the guest step before search where the true run did it afterward. The steps are still concrete enough to automate.
